title: 47:2 millstones/grind meal. This work of slaves (Judg. 16:21; Lam. 5:11-13) symbolizes the servitude into which Babylon (the wicked world) will be forced, as well as the end of a life of ease and opulence. In a literal sense, Babylon was forced to serve her masters when she fell. In a symbolic sense, the wicked (Babylon) serve their master, Satan. Satan promises the wicked a life of pleasure but delivers only bondage and pain. Only righteousness brings lasting rewards.
author: Tina M. Peterson
